segments.title: 第90章 我想你了
segments.content:
Reignition of Youth Chapter 90 I Missed You

A little past one in the afternoon.

Holding milk tea, the two of them strolled along Ningshan Avenue, passing through one of the few bustling pedestrian streets in northern Yinjiang District.

The middle section of this street, in particular, cut directly through the main campus of Qianjiang University, dividing it in two.

Among them, the south campus, built against the base of the adjacent Ningshan Mountain, primarily served as Qianjiang University's dormitory area.

And the north campus on the other side, built along the Yin River, was the main area for students' classes and activities.

Although people usually said Fuyi High was located next to Qianjiang University.

The more accurate description should be that Qianjiang University was the center, with a series of supporting facilities built around it.

Although both were schools, the difference in their area was just too great.

Qianjiang University covered an area at least ten times larger than Fuyi High.

Simply walking across Qianjiang University along Ningshan Avenue would take more than ten minutes.

"Should we go take a walk in Ningshan Park?" Ying Chanxi said to Li Luo with a spring in her step as she walked down the street, sipping the warm milk tea he had bought her.

"Okay," Li Luo nodded. "Let's go."

Inside Qianjiang University's south campus, near the foot of Ningshan Mountain, there was a rather famous park called Ningshan Park.

The campus itself was open to the public, so the two of them passed through the south campus gate smoothly, walked into the dormitory area, and ambled slowly toward Ningshan Park.

Even though it was the National Day holiday, many students had remained at Qianjiang University instead of choosing to go home.

Walking along the road, one could still see university students coming and going.

Li Luo and Ying Chanxi walking here didn't particularly stand out.

It was just that Ying Chanxi's pretty face and graceful figure would occasionally attract the gazes of a few passersby.

Walking through the dormitory area, Li Luo's gaze casually swept over the various shops below the dormitory buildings.

Small supermarkets, restaurants, cake shops, breakfast shops, fruit stands, and barbershops, it had everything.

The inside was virtually a miniature commercial and residential area.

Small as a sparrow, but it had all the vital organs.

For instance, during the military training before, the clothing store opposite Fuyi High had made a fortune in just a few days by supplying belts to these small supermarkets in the dormitory area.

Although it seemed like there were usually no outsiders here, the level of consumption was quite good.

On one hand, the local economy in Qianjiang Province was strong, and on the other, university students weren't particularly sensitive to consumption.

And often, they were easier to fool.

For the same barbershop, if opened in a university, the success rate of talking people into getting a membership card was much higher.

But this was just a fleeting thought for Li Luo.

The well-located storefronts within the area had long since been snapped up by others.

Especially those few small supermarkets with high foot traffic, one definitely couldn't get them without some connections.

"Li Luo, help me take a few pictures."

The two of them walked all the way through the dormitory area and arrived at Ningshan Park.

It was called a park, but it was actually just a mountain climbing entrance for Ningshan Mountain.

But after this entrance was renovated, a clear lake was at its gate, dotted with lotus leaves. A winding stone path on the water connected the two ends of the pond.

With the Ningshan scenery as a backdrop, it had a unique charm.

"Alright, alright, don't back up any further, be careful not to fall in." Li Luo held Ying Chanxi's phone to take pictures for her, reminding her as he snapped away.

Tourists like them who came to visit weren't uncommon during the National Day holiday.

So Ningshan Park was very lively.

The grandpas and grandmas living nearby also liked to come up the mountain from here to exercise.

Walking through the dormitory area, one could probably feel a taste of youth.

In addition, Ningshan Park was also an indispensable rendezvous spot for Qianjiang University students.

Every evening, if you picked up a stone and threw it into the pond, you were guaranteed to startle countless pairs of lovebirds by the shore.

"Sister, could you help us take a picture?" After having Li Luo finish taking photos, Ying Chanxi took her phone back to look, then politely found an auntie who was also visiting and asked for her help.

The auntie took Ying Chanxi's phone with a smile.

Ying Chanxi then quickly pulled Li Luo to the edge of the pond. "Hurry up, let's take a photo together."

As she spoke, Ying Chanxi had already pulled him into position, but she didn't retract her hand, just pretending to have forgotten as she left it resting on Li Luo's arm.

In the photo, as the auntie pressed the shutter, the image of Ying Chanxi seemingly snuggling up to Li Luo was permanently recorded.

"Thank you, sister!"

Ying Chanxi jogged over to get her phone back, lowering her head to admire it carefully.

Li Luo, at the side, also leaned over out of curiosity, but Ying Chanxi covered the phone with her hand.

"I can't even look?"

"Let's go, let's go." Ying Chanxi put her phone away. "After the park, let's go see the river."

"Sure."

The two of them left the south campus from another direction, then followed the western outer wall of the school, heading north toward the Yin River.

On the way, Li Luo's gaze fell on a large empty plot of land across the street.

In his memory, in about a year or two, construction on the Longhu Tianjie here should begin.

By then, there would be a new subway station entrance here, and another one on the east side of Fuyi High.

And with the completion of the subway station and the commercial center, the prices of everything nearby, whether residential or retail, would soar.

For example, these shops on the west side of Qianjiang University had average prices and cheap rent because the current foot traffic was more concentrated on the Ningshan Avenue pedestrian street.

But after the Longhu Tianjie across the street was built, the foot traffic in this area would be pulled up rapidly, becoming even busier than Ningshan Avenue.

If one were to look at it from the present perspective, an ordinary person would never imagine such a change.

To be honest, if one could buy a few shops on the west street in these two years, they would be set for life.

"What are you looking at?" Ying Chanxi followed Li Luo's line of sight to the shops on the side of the street, but she couldn't see anything special.

"Nothing." Li Luo shook his head, then asked with a smile, "I was just thinking about a question, what should a person do after achieving financial freedom?"

"Of course, they should pursue the things they love," Ying Chanxi said with a giggle.

"Do you have anything you love?"

"Of course I do." Ying Chanxi thought for a moment. "If I were truly financially free, I'd probably become a photographer."

"You like taking pictures?"

"Not just taking pictures. It could be recording a video, documenting life, or acting out a story."

"Then that's being a director."

"Haha, that's not impossible either." Ying Chanxi clasped her hands behind her back and hopped lightly a couple of times. "I'll hire you as my male lead then."

"My fee is very high."

"I'd already be financially free, would I be afraid of that?" Ying Chanxi raised an eyebrow and waved her hand grandly. "It wouldn't even be a problem to be your sugar mommy."

"You wish."

"What about you, Li Luo?" Ying Chanxi asked. "If you were financially free, what would you want to do?"

Asked this question by Ying Chanxi, Li Luo rare moment of contemplation.

Then he realized that he didn't seem to have a clear answer.

"I'd wish for world peace."

"What kind of answer is that?"

"What else?"

"I thought you were going to say you'd play computer games for the rest of your life."

"That's not out of the question either."

The two chatted idly as they walked, enjoying the breeze by the Yin River. The afternoon quickly and quietly slipped away.

Around four in the evening, the two first returned to Bihai Lanting, then went their separate ways.

Ying Chanxi went to meet Qiao Xinyan for dinner and shopping.

While Li Luo strolled home.

"Hello, Mom."

"Are you on your way back?"

"Yeah, Mom, I missed you."

"...Why are you suddenly saying something like that? Don't tell me you've run out of pocket money."

"Can't you think something good for a change?" Li Luo said with a speechless expression. "Can't I just miss you for no reason?"

"Just don't get into trouble at school." Lin Xiuhong said over the phone. "How much longer until you're home?"

"About half an hour," Li Luo said as he walked into a nearby bank. "I'll definitely be there before five."

"Alright, I got it."

He hung up the phone.

Ten minutes later, Li Luo walked out of the bank and hurried home.

(End of Chapter)
